Dune: Part Three (Presented in 70mm)

Secure your path, seal your fate.

Tickets are on Monday, August 24 at 11:00 am for advance screenings at the Park Theatre Vancouver.

Thursday, December 24
Doors 1:30 pm | Movie 2:00 pm *Start time subject to change. Please arrive on time.

Emperor Paul Atreides faces the consequences of his reign as old allies return, terrifying new threats emerge, and betrayal lurks in every shadow. As rebellion brews and enemies close in, Paul must confront the true cost of power and the fate of those he loves the most.

DUNE: PART THREE (Denis Villeneuve, 2026 / 140 mins / NR) Emperor Paul Atreides faces the fallout from his ascent to power as political plots and a galaxy-wide holy war endanger the future only he can see.
